criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First line names the subject, the dollar amount, the acquired company, the date, and the strategic stake in one sentence. Decision is the hook, not the bio. Minor deduction: the subject's role (CEO) does not appear until paragraph 2.

criteria.name: Subject + decision load-bearing for AK
criteria.notes: Duncan is the named CEO-decision-owner of Alaska's largest telecom. The decision consolidates both of the state's private subsea fiber networks for $310M-plus. Consequence is named with sector, dollar figures, named affected actors (rural carriers, ANCs, healthcare systems, JBER, Eielson, North Slope AI proposals), and a timeframe.

criteria.name: Subject identification fidelity
criteria.notes: Full name (Ron Duncan), role (CEO and co-founder), org (GCI Communication Corp), and Anchorage tie (headquartered on Denali St, leading the company since 1979) all present and match the dossier.

criteria.name: Decision specificity + primary-source
criteria.notes: What/when/binary all present. Primary source cited inline, two independent corroborators named (ADN, KUCB). Decision date within the authorized 90-day broadened window. Minor deduction: 'signed off on' is a slightly informal rendering of the binary.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Takes a real, honest, evidence-grounded position on both sides (resilience gain vs. monopoly/leverage cost). Closing judgment is earned by evidence, not manufactured. No boosterism, no hagiographic verbs.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Names the next decision (regulatory review outcome), the window, and what to watch for. Minor deduction for vague timing ('sometime in 2026').

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, Alaska-first throughout. No hagiographic verbs, no press-release cadence, no banned phrases.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 419 body words (within 350-475). Total 2,757 characters (under 3,000 cap). Paragraphs are 2-4 sentences. Bio confined to one sentence.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closes with a real, debatable industry question tied directly to the post's structural tension between monopoly risk and resilience gain.

criteria.name: Credibility guard
criteria.notes: Every claim traces to primary source or independent corroborators. Quote attributed to Wailand (not Duncan), matching the dossier's explicit caveat. AI data-center link explicitly caveated inline.
